info.text: Brave one, Grassland Worgs from the the Worg Lair have recently been attacking peasants around the village causing much damage and distress.
Maybe people should not live in such a dangerous place.
There are fewer and fewer safe places in this world.
Well, I will kill any wolves that cross our path, but I'll not seek them out for the slaughter. Even beasts must fight to live.
The wolves are infected with an evil presence, a presence slowly filling our world. The wolves are not the illness, but rather only a symptom.
What is the cause?
That...is unknown. But it will take a great hero to fight it.
You believe I am this 'hero?'
Only the gods know that.

info.text: This is the Baylon Plains, an area known for its beauty and abundance. It was named for the famed beauty, Queen Baylon.
It has been overrun by Taurens and other beasts. The place has been burned and the people have fled.
What creatures plague this area?

There is a gang known as the Brothers Tauren, three exceptional Tauren generals who have single-handedly sought to destroy the human race and relive the glory days when Taurens ruled all. The amount of blood already on their hands in unimaginable!

The Empire has been weakened by years of fighting this unknown evil that has been growing in the world. It doesn't have any army to send. So warlords like these brothers have stepped up to take control of large areas of Gaia.
So it is up to the people to defend themselves?
*nods* People who have not the means to do so. But I am confident that like the great hero Aklorn, the gods will send a new hero to save them.
Perhaps they could hurry up about it.
